altSql: SELECT SUM(s) AS total_amount FROM (SELECT oi.amount AS s FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成'))
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成')
SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND substr(created_at, 1, 7) = '2025-02')
note: 字符串前缀截取定月 + IN 子查询

altSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND substr(o.created_at, 1, 4) = '2025'
note: 年份前缀代替区间比较

altSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND date(o.created_at) >= date('2026-08-31', '-29 day')
note: date 修饰符表达式代替字面量区间（结果须逐分一致）

altSql: SELECT '2026-07' AS month, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND substr(o.created_at, 1, 7) = '2026-07' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-08', SUM(oi.amount) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND substr(o.created_at, 1, 7) = '2026-08'
note: UNION 拆月代替 GROUP BY

altSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.category
note: JOIN 顺序反转（products 领头）

altSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = '华东'))
note: 双层 IN 子查询代替链式 JOIN

altSql: SELECT t.level, SUM(t.amt) / COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT c.level AS level, o.id AS oid, SUM(oi.amount) AS amt FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.level, o.id) t GROUP BY t.level
note: 先按（等级,订单）预聚合再除订单数 —— 扇出免疫的写法，必须与 DISTINCT 计数等值

altSql: SELECT t.ch, SUM(t.amt) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT COALESCE(o.channel, '未知') AS ch, o.id AS oid, SUM(oi.amount) AS amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY COALESCE(o.channel, '未知'), o.id) t GROUP BY t.ch
note: 先按订单预聚合再按渠道汇总

altSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成')
note: IN 子查询（同 A4 结构，独立锚定 D1 语义）

altSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.amount) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost) AS gross_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.category
note: (Σamount − Σquantity×cost) 代替 Σ(unit−cost)×qty —— 表达式树不同，浮点末位差靠比对器容差吸收

altSql: SELECT SUM(t.amt) / COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.amount) AS amt FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY o.id) t
note: 预聚合到订单粒度再平均，天然免疫扇出

altSql: SELECT t.name, t.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.name AS name, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_spent FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5) t
note: 子查询内排序截断再外层取出

altSql: SELECT t.id, t.order_amount FROM (SELECT o.id AS id, SUM(oi.amount) AS order_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY order_amount DESC LIMIT 5) t
